title: AgenTest: Mining Business Rules to Test LLM Agents for Business Logic Bugs
title_zh: AgenTest：挖掘业务规则以测试LLM智能体的业务逻辑缺陷

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute business operations through tools and interact directly with application data and services. Beyond completing user requests, these agents must obey domain-specific business rules that constrain when actions are permitted and what data or resources may be affected. Violating such rules can lead to business logic bugs , even when a task appears successful. Detecting these bugs is difficult because the rules are rarely available as explicit, testable specifications. They are distributed across system prompts and tool definitions, while others remain implicit in domain knowledge. Existing agent testing approaches typically evaluate task success, predefined policies, or known attack scenarios. This limits their ability to systematically uncover previously unspecified business-rule violations.

paragraphs.en: We present AgenTest , which mines business rules from system prompts, tool definitions, and domain knowledge, refines them into Given–When–Then specifications, and systematically tests each specification. For each extracted specification, AgenTest instantiates its Given conditions by constructing a satisfying environment state and simulated user, exercises the agent through multi-turn interactions, and checks its Then conditions over messages, tool calls, and state changes using a hybrid oracle. On the airline, retail, and telecom agents of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench with two underlying models, AgenTest produces 551 refined specifications, and detects violations of 89 and 121 distinct specifications, respectively—3.4 × \times and 2.5 × \times as many as all baselines combined. Only AgenTest detects cases where an agent improperly accesses or modifies another user’s data. Moreover, about 60% of bug-triggering runs cannot be detected from the final state alone, highlighting the need to check the full interaction against explicit business rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AgenTest，它从系统提示词、工具定义和领域知识中挖掘业务规则，将其细化为 Given–When–Then 规格说明，并系统地测试每一条规格说明。 对于每条提取出的规格说明，AgenTest 通过构造满足条件的环境状态和模拟用户来实例化其 Given 条件，通过多轮交互来驱动智能体运行，并使用混合判定器（hybrid oracle）在消息、工具调用和状态变化上检查其 Then 条件。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 的航空、零售和电信智能体以及两个底层模型上，AgenTest 生成 551 条细化的规格说明，分别检测出 89 条和 121 条不同规格说明的违规——是所有基线方法总和的 3.4 × \times 倍和 2.5 × \times 倍。 只有 AgenTest 能检测出智能体不当访问或修改其他用户数据的情形。 此外，约 60% 触发缺陷的运行无法仅凭最终状态检测出来，这凸显了对照明确的业务规则检查完整交互过程的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute business operations through external tools. Customer-service agents, for example, can modify orders, issue refunds, cancel subscriptions, and update information through backend APIs ( Intercom, 2026 ) . Such agents are becoming part of the business software they serve: they must not only complete user requests, but also obey the business rules that govern when and how those requests may be carried out. We study these tool-using agents ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Bajoria et al., 2026 ; Nan et al., 2024 ) , which act by selecting and invoking tools such as database queries and application APIs.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过外部工具执行业务操作。 例如，客服智能体可以通过后端 API 修改订单、发放退款、取消订阅和更新信息（Intercom, 2026）。 此类智能体正成为其所服务的业务软件的一部分：它们不仅要完成用户请求，还必须遵守规定这些请求何时以及如何被执行的业务规则。 我们研究这些使用工具的智能体（Yao et al., 2022; Bajoria et al., 2026; Nan et al., 2024），它们通过选择并调用诸如数据库查询和应用 API 等工具来执行操作。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents are different from conventional software. In conventional systems, business logic is typically encoded explicitly in program code through deterministic control flow, authorization checks, validation conditions, and data constraints. These mechanisms precisely define which operations are allowed under which conditions. In LLM agents, however, part of this logic is delegated to the model: behavioral requirements are expressed in natural-language prompts, shaped by tool definitions, and interpreted dynamically during interaction. As a result, the agent often lacks the explicit and deterministic business-logic constraints provided by conventional code. A rule may be followed in one conversation but violated in another depending on how the request is phrased, what context is available, or how the interaction unfolds. When such agents directly operate on business data and services, this uncertainty can translate into concrete business risks, such as unauthorized operations, incorrect transactions, or violations of required workflows.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体与传统软件不同。 在传统系统中，业务逻辑通常通过确定性控制流、授权检查、验证条件和数据约束，显式地编码在程序代码中。 这些机制精确定义了在何种条件下允许执行哪些操作。 然而在 LLM 智能体中，这部分逻辑被委托给了模型：行为要求以自然语言提示的形式表达，受工具定义塑造，并在交互过程中被动态解释。 因此，智能体往往缺乏传统代码所提供的显式且确定性的业务逻辑约束。 同一条规则可能在这一轮对话中被遵守，却在另一轮对话中被违反，这取决于请求如何表述、有哪些可用上下文，以及交互如何展开。 当此类智能体直接操作业务数据和服务时，这种不确定性可能转化为具体的业务风险，例如未授权操作、错误交易或违反规定的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches to testing LLM agents largely fall into two categories. The first focuses on general security threats, such as jailbreaks, prompt injection, malicious tool use, and other adversarial behaviors ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Ruan et al., 2024 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) . These approaches are important for security, but they do not target the domain-specific business rules that govern legitimate operations. The second evaluates business functionality through predefined tasks and manually specified expected outcomes, as in benchmarks such as τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) . Such tests can check whether an agent behaves correctly on known scenarios, but they require developers or benchmark designers to specify in advance what behavior to exercise and how to judge the result.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的测试智能体的方法大致分为两类。 第一类关注通用安全威胁，例如越狱、提示注入、恶意工具使用以及其他对抗性行为（Debenedetti et al., 2024; Zhan et al., 2024; Ruan et al., 2024; Andriushchenko et al., 2025）。 这些方法对安全而言很重要，但它们并没有针对约束合法运营的领域特定业务规则。 第二类通过预定义的任务和人工指定的预期结果来评估业务功能，例如 τ²-bench 等基准测试（Barres et al., 2025）。 这类测试可以检查智能体在已知场景下是否表现正确，但需要开发者或基准设计者预先指定要测试哪些行为以及如何评判结果。

paragraphs.en: This leaves a fundamental gap for business logic testing: the rules to be tested may not be explicitly available. They can be distributed across the system prompt and tool definitions, or remain implicit in domain semantics. Figure 1 illustrates this problem. Alice asks the airline agent to add a checked bag to a reservation owned by Bob. The agent performs the update without establishing that Alice owns the reservation, charges Bob’s credit card, and reports success. The run satisfies the requested functionality and ends in a valid state, yet violates the business rule that a reservation may be modified only at the request of its owner. This rule is not explicitly stated in any single artifact: the prompt requires user identification, and the tool accepts a reservation identifier, but neither states that the requester must match the reservation owner. A predefined functional test will detect this bug only if a human has already anticipated this rule, constructed the corresponding scenario, and provided an oracle for it.

paragraphs.en: Even after such a rule is discovered, automatically testing it remains challenging. Business rules are typically abstract constraints rather than executable test cases: they do not directly specify what state should be created, how the interaction should unfold, or what observations constitute a violation. A tester must therefore operationalize each rule into a concrete scenario that can exercise the relevant behavior and provide a reliable oracle for judging the execution. This is particularly difficult for LLM agents because violations may depend on the conversation trajectory and may only be observable in intermediate messages or tool calls rather than in the final state.
paragraphs.zh: 即使发现了这样的规则，对其进行自动化测试仍然具有挑战性。 业务规则通常是抽象约束而非可执行的测试用例：它们并不直接指明应创建什么状态、交互应如何展开，或哪些观察结果构成违规。 因此，测试人员必须将每条规则具体化为一个可执行的场景，以便锻炼相关行为，并提供可靠的判定标准（oracle）来评估执行情况。 这对LLM智能体来说尤为困难，因为违规可能依赖于对话轨迹，并且可能只在中间消息或工具调用中才可观察到，而非体现在最终状态中。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is to make each business rule an explicit test target and use it to drive the entire testing process. We present AgenTest , a specification-driven approach that mines business rules from the system prompt, tool definitions, and domain knowledge, and refines them into Given–When–Then specifications. The system prompt is a primary source of explicit behavioral requirements, while tool definitions characterize the business operations the agent can perform and the data and arguments on which those operations depend. Considering both is therefore necessary to recover rules that govern not only what the agent is instructed to do, but also how those instructions constrain concrete actions in the environment.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, AgenTest combines three techniques. It first mines candidate rules from prompts and tool definitions and augments them with domain knowledge, then refines them into precise Given–When–Then specifications. For each specification, AgenTest constructs an environment state and simulated user that satisfy its Given preconditions, drives multi-turn interactions to exercise the relevant behavior, and checks whether the resulting messages, tool calls, and state changes satisfy its Then postconditions. The specification serves not only as an oracle, but also as a driver for generating the scenario and interaction needed to expose a violation. Finally, it checks the resulting execution with a hybrid oracle that combines deterministic checks over structured behaviors with LLM judgments for natural-language conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，AgenTest 结合了三种技术。 它首先从提示词和工具定义中挖掘候选规则，并用领域知识对其进行增补，然后将这些规则精化为精确的 Given–When–Then 规约。 对于每条规约，AgenTest 构造满足其 Given 前置条件的环境状态和模拟用户，通过多轮交互驱动以触发相关行为，并检查由此产生的消息、工具调用和状态变更是否满足其 Then 后置条件。 规约不仅充当判定基准，还作为驱动器，用于生成暴露违规所需的场景和交互。 最后，它使用混合判定基准检查所产生的执行过程，该基准将对结构化行为的确定性检查与针对自然语言条件的大语言模型判断相结合。

paragraphs.en: A tool-using agent is an LLM-based system that invokes external tools to perform tasks for users ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) , such as booking flights, returning products, or resolving connectivity issues in customer service. Over a multi-turn conversation, the agent gathers information from the user and calls tools to read or modify an environment of business data, such as user records, orders, and reservations. The environment may also include user-side resources, such as phone settings, that the user operates at the agent’s request. Both tool calls and user operations change the environment state, and their results inform the agent’s next action. Throughout this interaction, the agent must satisfy business specifications, such as verifying that a reservation belongs to the requesting user and obtaining explicit confirmation before modifying it. These specifications are typically embedded in system prompts, tool interface definitions, and tool documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 使用工具的智能体是一种基于大语言模型的系统，它通过调用外部工具为用户执行任务（Yao 等，2025；Barres 等，2025），例如预订航班、退回商品，或在客服场景中解决连接问题。 在多轮对话中，智能体从用户处收集信息，并调用工具来读取或修改业务数据环境，例如用户记录、订单和预订。 该环境还可能包括用户侧的资源，例如手机设置，用户可根据智能体的请求对其进行操作。 工具调用和用户操作都会改变环境状态，其结果会影响智能体的下一步行动。 在整个交互过程中，智能体必须满足业务规范，例如验证某项预订是否属于发起请求的用户，并在修改之前获得明确确认。 这些规范通常嵌入在系统提示词、工具接口定义和工具文档中。

It defines the conditions under which the rule applies ( preconditions ), the relevant event or action being exercised, and the required or prohibited behavior ( postconditions ), including any applicable exceptions.

paragraphs.en: Given a tool-using agent A A and its environment E E , but without an explicit set of business specifications, our goal is to automatically (1) derive a set S S of business specifications governing A A , (2) operationalize each specification into executable tests that exercise the conditions under which it applies, and (3) within a testing budget, discover as many business logic bugs ( s , τ ) (s,\tau) as possible, where s ∈ S s\in S and τ \tau is an execution trace that violates s s .
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个使用工具的智能体 A A 及其环境 E E，在没有明确业务规范集合的情况下，我们的目标是自动地：(1) 推导出一组约束 A A 的业务规范集合 S S；(2) 将每条规范操作化为可执行的测试，以检验其适用条件；(3) 在测试预算内，尽可能多地发现业务逻辑缺陷 ( s , τ ) (s,\tau)，其中 s ∈ S s\in S 且 τ \tau 是违反 s s 的执行轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents an overview of AgenTest , which comprises two stages: Specification Mining and Refinement and Specification-Driven Testing .
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了 AgenTest 的概览，它包含两个阶段：规约挖掘与精炼（Specification Mining and Refinement）和规约驱动的测试（Specification-Driven Testing）。

paragraphs.en: The first stage mines business rules from system prompts and tool definitions, supplemented with candidates inferred from LLM domain knowledge. It deduplicates the candidates, filters out those relying on concepts absent from the agent’s environment, and refines the remaining rules into scenario-specific Given–When–Then specification ( North, 2006 ) , making their preconditions, triggers, and expected behavior explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段从系统提示词和工具定义中挖掘业务规则，并用从大语言模型领域知识推断出的候选规则作为补充。 它对候选规则去重，过滤掉那些依赖于智能体环境中不存在的概念的规则，并将剩余规则细化为面向特定场景的Given–When–Then规格（North, 2006），使其前提条件、触发条件和预期行为显式化。

sents.zh: 第一阶段从系统提示词和工具定义中挖掘业务规则，并用从大语言模型领域知识推断出的候选规则作为补充。

paragraphs.en: The second stage tests the agent against each refined specification. It constructs a test driver that establishes the preconditions through environment setup and initializes a simulated user with the corresponding knowledge and goal. It then selects and adapts an interaction strategy to guide the multi-turn conversation, using a bug experience memory to prioritize strategies that previously exposed bugs. Finally, a hybrid oracle detects violations by checking specification-derived assertions against messages, tool calls, and state changes through deterministic checks and evidence-backed LLM judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段针对每个细化后的规格对智能体进行测试。 它构建一个测试驱动器，通过环境搭建建立前置条件，并初始化一个具备相应知识和目标的模拟用户。 随后，它选择并调整一种交互策略来引导多轮对话，利用缺陷经验记忆优先选择此前曾暴露出缺陷的策略。 最后，混合判定器通过确定性检查和有证据支持的 LLM 判断，依据规格导出的断言对消息、工具调用和状态变更进行核查，以检测违规情况。

paragraphs.en: Tool-using agents often lack standalone business requirements documents. Although specifications may be embedded in implementation artifacts such as system prompts and tool definitions, these artifacts may leave some expected business behavior unstated. Moreover, a single specification may cover multiple business scenarios with different applicability conditions. To test these scenarios separately, the conditions and corresponding behavioral constraints must be made explicit for each scenario. To address these challenges, AgenTest combines multi-source specification mining from agent artifacts and LLM domain knowledge with specification refinement that turns the mined rules into explicit test targets.
paragraphs.zh: 使用工具的智能体往往缺乏独立的业务需求文档。 尽管规格说明可能嵌入在系统提示词和工具定义等实现产物中，但这些产物可能未明确表述某些预期的业务行为。 此外，单一规格说明可能涵盖适用条件不同的多个业务场景。 为了分别测试这些场景，必须为每个场景明确其条件及相应的行为约束。 为应对这些挑战，AgenTest 将来自智能体产物的多源规格说明挖掘与 LLM 领域知识相结合，并通过规格说明精化将挖掘出的规则转化为明确的测试目标。

sents.zh: 使用工具的智能体往往缺乏独立的业务需求文档。

sents.en: To address these challenges, AgenTest combines multi-source specification mining from agent artifacts and LLM domain knowledge with specification refinement that turns the mined rules into explicit test targets.
sents.zh: 为应对这些挑战，AgenTest 将来自智能体产物的多源规格说明挖掘与 LLM 领域知识相结合，并通过规格说明精化将挖掘出的规则转化为明确的测试目标。

paragraphs.en: To recover business rule from agent artifacts and implicit domain expectations, AgenTest extracts rule from tool definitions and system prompts, and uses LLM domain knowledge to infer additional candidates. Because these sources express constraints at different levels of abstraction, AgenTest uses a separate mining procedure for each source. The resulting candidates are then validated and deduplicated to form the specification set for refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 为了从智能体产物和隐式领域期望中恢复业务规则，AgenTest 从工具定义和系统提示中提取规则，并利用大语言模型的领域知识推断出额外的候选规则。 由于这些来源在不同抽象层次上表达约束，AgenTest 针对每个来源使用单独的挖掘流程。 随后对得到的候选规则进行验证与去重，以构成用于细化的规格集合。

sents.zh: 为了从智能体产物和隐式领域期望中恢复业务规则，AgenTest 从工具定义和系统提示中提取规则，并利用大语言模型的领域知识推断出额外的候选规则。

paragraphs.en: Agents invoke tools to perform business operations. Tool schemas, function signatures, and docstrings describe the accepted arguments and may indicate dependencies between these operations. AgenTest extracts specifications from these sources, including argument constraints within individual calls and ordering constraints across calls to different tools. It uses an LLM to interpret natural-language descriptions alongside structured interface information.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体调用工具以执行业务操作。 工具模式、函数签名和文档字符串描述了可接受的参数，并可能指示这些操作之间的依赖关系。 AgenTest 从这些来源中提取规约，包括单次调用内的参数约束以及跨不同工具调用的顺序约束。 它使用大语言模型来解读自然语言描述以及结构化的接口信息。

sents.en: Agents invoke tools to perform business operations.
sents.zh: 智能体调用工具以执行业务操作。

sents.en: Tool schemas, function signatures, and docstrings describe the accepted arguments and may indicate dependencies between these operations.
sents.zh: 工具模式、函数签名和文档字符串描述了可接受的参数，并可能指示这些操作之间的依赖关系。

sents.en: AgenTest extracts specifications from these sources, including argument constraints within individual calls and ordering constraints across calls to different tools.
sents.zh: AgenTest 从这些来源中提取规约，包括单次调用内的参数约束以及跨不同工具调用的顺序约束。

sents.en: It uses an LLM to interpret natural-language descriptions alongside structured interface information.
sents.zh: 它使用大语言模型来解读自然语言描述以及结构化的接口信息。

paragraphs.en: For argument constraints, the LLM examines parameter names, types, descriptions, enumerations, and examples to extract formats, ranges, allowed values, and relationships between arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 对于参数约束，LLM 会检查参数名称、类型、描述、枚举和示例，以提取格式、取值范围、允许的取值以及参数之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: For ordering constraints, the LLM examines tool input and output descriptions to identify dependencies between tools. If tool B B requires an input that can only be obtained from tool A A ’s output, then A A must be called before B B . A separate LLM check removes candidate dependencies when the required input can be supplied directly by the user. For example, the agent need not call a reservation lookup tool before a cancellation tool merely to obtain the reservation identifier if the user can provide it directly.
paragraphs.zh: 对于顺序约束，大语言模型会检查工具的输入和输出描述，以识别工具之间的依赖关系。 如果工具 B B 需要的输入只能从工具 A A 的输出获得，那么必须先调用 A A 再调用 B B 。 一项独立的大语言模型检查会在所需输入可由用户直接提供时移除候选依赖关系。 例如，如果用户可以直接提供预订标识符，智能体就不必为了获取该标识符而在调用取消工具之前先调用预订查询工具。

sents.en: For ordering constraints, the LLM examines tool input and output descriptions to identify dependencies between tools.
sents.zh: 对于顺序约束，大语言模型会检查工具的输入和输出描述，以识别工具之间的依赖关系。

sents.en: If tool B B requires an input that can only be obtained from tool A A ’s output, then A A must be called before B B .
sents.zh: 如果工具 B B 需要的输入只能从工具 A A 的输出获得，那么必须先调用 A A 再调用 B B 。

sents.zh: 例如，如果用户可以直接提供预订标识符，智能体就不必为了获取该标识符而在调用取消工具之前先调用预订查询工具。

paragraphs.en: System prompts describe how an agent should perform tasks and interact with users. Business rule may appear as explicit instructions or factual statements, with conditions and exceptions provided elsewhere in the prompt. AgenTest therefore extracts rule from the complete prompt to preserve this context. For rules governing business operations, it also identifies the tools that perform those operations so that subsequent tests can check the agent’s compliance when performing them. Since the initial extraction may miss rules or relevant tools, AgenTest checks both source coverage and tool bindings.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示词描述智能体应如何执行任务并与用户交互。 业务规则可能以明确的指令或事实陈述的形式出现，其条件和例外情况在提示词的其他位置给出。 因此，AgenTest 从完整提示词中提取规则，以保留这一上下文。 对于管理业务操作的规则，它还会识别执行这些操作的工具，以便后续测试能够检查智能体在执行这些操作时是否合规。 由于初始提取可能会遗漏规则或相关工具，AgenTest 会同时检查来源覆盖率和工具绑定情况。

sents.en: System prompts describe how an agent should perform tasks and interact with users.
sents.zh: 系统提示词描述智能体应如何执行任务并与用户交互。

sents.en: Business rule may appear as explicit instructions or factual statements, with conditions and exceptions provided elsewhere in the prompt.
sents.zh: 业务规则可能以明确的指令或事实陈述的形式出现，其条件和例外情况在提示词的其他位置给出。

sents.en: AgenTest therefore extracts rule from the complete prompt to preserve this context.
sents.zh: 因此，AgenTest 从完整提示词中提取规则，以保留这一上下文。

sents.en: For rules governing business operations, it also identifies the tools that perform those operations so that subsequent tests can check the agent’s compliance when performing them.
sents.zh: 对于管理业务操作的规则，它还会识别执行这些操作的工具，以便后续测试能够检查智能体在执行这些操作时是否合规。

sents.zh: 由于初始提取可能会遗漏规则或相关工具，AgenTest 会同时检查来源覆盖率和工具绑定情况。

paragraphs.en: For initial extraction, the LLM receives the complete system prompt and the available tool definitions. Each extracted specification includes the business rule, a supporting quotation, and, where applicable, the tools and parameters it constrains. Specifications concerning conversational behavior alone need not be bound to a tool.
paragraphs.zh: 在初始抽取时，大语言模型会接收完整的系统提示词以及可用的工具定义。 每条抽取出的规范都包含业务规则、一条支撑性引文，以及在适用情况下其所约束的工具和参数。 仅涉及对话行为的规范无需绑定到某个智能体工具上。

sents.en: For initial extraction, the LLM receives the complete system prompt and the available tool definitions.
sents.zh: 在初始抽取时，大语言模型会接收完整的系统提示词以及可用的工具定义。

sents.en: Each extracted specification includes the business rule, a supporting quotation, and, where applicable, the tools and parameters it constrains.
sents.zh: 每条抽取出的规范都包含业务规则、一条支撑性引文，以及在适用情况下其所约束的工具和参数。

sents.en: Specifications concerning conversational behavior alone need not be bound to a tool.
sents.zh: 仅涉及对话行为的规范无需绑定到某个智能体工具上。

paragraphs.en: To identify potential omissions, AgenTest tracks which passages are cited as evidence for the extracted specifications. It segments the prompt into passages for coverage accounting without changing the full text presented to the LLM. The LLM associates each specification’s quotations with source passages, and AgenTest checks these associations against the original text. Each uncited passage is then assessed by the LLM in context to determine whether it contains no business rule, provides additional evidence for an existing specification, or expresses a missing rule. Passages supporting an existing specification are added to its evidence, while passages expressing missing rules produce new specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 为识别潜在的遗漏，AgenTest 跟踪哪些段落被引用为所提取规格的证据。 它将提示词切分为段落以进行覆盖率统计，而不改变呈现给大语言模型（LLM）的完整文本。 大语言模型将每条规格的引文与源段落关联起来，AgenTest 则对照原文核查这些关联。 随后，大语言模型在上下文中评估每个未被引用的段落，以判断其是不包含业务规则、为现有规格提供补充证据，还是表达了缺失的规则。 支持现有规格的段落会被加入该规格的证据，而表达缺失规则的段落则生成新的规格。

sents.en: To identify potential omissions, AgenTest tracks which passages are cited as evidence for the extracted specifications.
sents.zh: 为识别潜在的遗漏，AgenTest 跟踪哪些段落被引用为所提取规格的证据。

sents.zh: 它将提示词切分为段落以进行覆盖率统计，而不改变呈现给大语言模型（LLM）的完整文本。

sents.zh: 随后，大语言模型在上下文中评估每个未被引用的段落，以判断其是不包含业务规则、为现有规格提供补充证据，还是表达了缺失的规则。

sents.en: Passages supporting an existing specification are added to its evidence, while passages expressing missing rules produce new specifications.
sents.zh: 支持现有规格的段落会被加入该规格的证据，而表达缺失规则的段落则生成新的规格。

paragraphs.en: To identify missing tool bindings, AgenTest checks whether the wording of a specification applies to operations beyond those already associated with it. For example, a rule requiring confirmation before any reservation update may apply to both flight-change and baggage-update tools, even if it appears in a section discussing only one of them. AgenTest screens specifications for such broader applicability and asks the LLM to assess the potentially missing bindings. Each proposed binding must include a supporting quotation that is checked against the specification and its source evidence before the binding is accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别缺失的工具绑定，AgenTest 会检查某条规范的措辞是否也适用于除已关联操作之外的其他操作。 例如，一条要求在任何预订更新前进行确认的规则，可能同时适用于改签工具和行李更新工具，即使它出现在仅讨论其中某一工具的章节中。 AgenTest 会筛查规范是否存在此类更广泛的适用性，并让大语言模型评估可能缺失的绑定。 每个提出的绑定都必须包含一条支持性引文，在接受该绑定之前，会对照规范及其来源证据对引文进行核查。

sents.en: To identify missing tool bindings, AgenTest checks whether the wording of a specification applies to operations beyond those already associated with it.
sents.zh: 为了识别缺失的工具绑定，AgenTest 会检查某条规范的措辞是否也适用于除已关联操作之外的其他操作。

sents.zh: AgenTest 会筛查规范是否存在此类更广泛的适用性，并让大语言模型评估可能缺失的绑定。

sents.zh: 每个提出的绑定都必须包含一条支持性引文，在接受该绑定之前，会对照规范及其来源证据对引文进行核查。

To keep these candidates relevant to the agent, AgenTest bases inference on the available tools. The LLM first examines each tool separately and then considers constraints across multiple calls.

sents.en: The LLM first examines each tool separately and then considers constraints across multiple calls.
sents.zh: 大语言模型首先单独审查每个工具，然后考虑跨多次调用的约束。

paragraphs.en: For each tool, the LLM uses its purpose, parameters, and whether it reads or modifies data to infer unstated specifications along four dimensions. Argument constraints capture domain-specific restrictions on input values and relationships between parameters. Environment-state constraints concern whether the affected object exists, belongs to the requesting user, and is in a state that permits the operation. Ordering constraints specify checks, information collection, or confirmation steps that must precede the operation. Behavioral norms describe what the agent should or should not say or do when handling the operation. These dimensions guide inference without requiring every tool to yield a specification in each category.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个工具，LLM 利用其用途、参数以及是读取还是修改数据，沿四个维度推断未明确说明的规范。 参数约束刻画输入值的领域特定限制以及参数之间的关系。 环境状态约束涉及受影响的对象是否存在、是否属于发起请求的用户，以及是否处于允许该操作的状态。 顺序约束指定必须在执行该操作之前进行的检查、信息收集或确认步骤。 行为规范描述智能体在处理该操作时应该或不应该说什么、做什么。 这些维度为推断提供指导，但不要求每个工具在每个类别中都产出一条规范。

paragraphs.en: Other specifications concern how the effects of one call constrain later calls or accumulate across an interaction. AgenTest therefore provides the LLM with the full tool set and guides inference using three patterns. First, a call may change a resource’s state and thereby make subsequent operations on that resource invalid. For example, suspending a service line may prevent later calls that require the line to be active. Second, individually acceptable calls may exceed a limit when their effects are accumulated, such as issuing multiple compensation certificates for the same incident. Third, closing or releasing a resource may prohibit further use or modification, such as changing the settings of a terminated service line.
paragraphs.zh: 其他规范涉及一次调用的效果如何约束后续调用，或在一次交互中如何累积。 因此，AgenTest 向 LLM 提供完整的工具集，并使用三种模式来引导推理。 首先，一次调用可能改变某个资源的状态，从而使后续对该资源的操作失效。 例如，暂停一条服务线路可能会阻止后续需要该线路处于活跃状态的调用。 其次，单独来看可接受的调用在效果累积后可能超出限制，例如为同一事故签发多份补偿证明。 第三，关闭或释放某个资源可能禁止其进一步使用或修改，例如更改已终止服务线路的设置。

paragraphs.en: Specifications mined from the three sources may overlap. A format constraint stated in a tool description is often also stated in the system prompt, and domain-knowledge inference may derive it a third time. Moreover, because domain-knowledge inference draws on the LLM’s prior knowledge of the domain rather than on the agent’s artifacts, an inferred specification may not apply to the agent under test. It may rely on a concept that the agent’s environment never defines, so that no execution could show a violation. For example, “all passengers must be eligible to travel on the selected flight” presupposes a notion of eligibility that neither the system prompt nor the data model of the airline agent has. To address these problems, we design a two-layer LLM-based filter. The first layer removes duplicates. The LLM groups specifications that constrain the same operation and impose the same obligation on it, and it keeps specifications apart when their equivalence is uncertain. Within a group, AgenTest retains the specification from the most reliable source, schema over prompt over domain knowledge, and merges the evidence of the others into it. The second layer checks the remaining domain-knowledge specifications for applicability to the agent. To make this judgment reliable, AgenTest provides the LLM with the environment the agent operates on, namely its data model, its tool list, and its system prompt. For every limit, status, or condition the specification relies on, the LLM points to the field, system-prompt sentence, or tool parameter that defines it, and code verifies that what it points to exists. If some concept the specification relies on has no such definition, no observation of the agent could establish a violation, and the specification is removed. A specification that constrains only what a tool returns is removed as well, since the agent cannot violate it.

paragraphs.en: A mined specification may govern the same business decision in several scenarios. For example, the airline cancellation specification permits cancellation under four alternative conditions and forbids it otherwise. Testing such a specification as a whole is imprecise: a test exercises only one of its scenarios, and the conditions, trigger, and expected behavior that the test requires remain implicit. To address this, AgenTest refines each mined specification in two steps. Scenario derivation splits the specification into the scenarios it covers. Given–When–Then encoding expresses each scenario as a refined specification in Given–When–Then form that makes the preconditions, triggering request or event, and expected behavior explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 挖掘得到的规约可能在多个场景中约束同一个业务决策。 例如，航空公司的取消规约允许在四个备选条件下取消订单，否则禁止取消。 将这样的规约作为整体进行测试并不精确：一个测试只覆盖其场景之一，而该测试所需的条件、触发器和期望行为仍然是隐式的。 为解决这一问题，AgenTest 通过两个步骤细化每条挖掘得到的规约。 场景推导将该规约拆分为它所覆盖的各个场景。 Given–When–Then 编码将每个场景表示为一条以 Given–When–Then 形式表述的细化规约，使前置条件、触发请求或事件以及期望行为变得显式。

A specification that permits an operation only when C C holds also prohibits it whenever C C fails, and this prohibition is where violations occur. paragraphs.en: For example, a cancellation specification lists four eligibility conditions: the booking was made within 24 hours, the flight was cancelled by the airline, the reservation is for a business flight, or the user has insurance covering the cancellation reason. It also derives two scenarios in which cancellation is prohibited: the first three conditions are false, and the user either has no insurance or has insurance that does not cover the reason. The insurance condition thus remains a conjunction rather than treating insurance alone as sufficient. Scenarios need not be mutually exclusive; a recently booked business flight can satisfy more than one eligibility condition.

paragraphs.en: Using a derived scenario for testing requires distinguishing its preconditions, the request or event that exercises the specification, and the behavior to check. AgenTest adopts the Given–When–Then (GWT) template from behavior-driven development ( North, 2006 ; Cucumber, 2026 ; Binamungu et al., 2018 ; De Biase et al., 2024 ) to represent these elements explicitly in a common structure. The LLM encodes each scenario as a specification s = ( G , W , T ) s=(G,W,T) . Given ( G G ) states the applicable conditions, including relevant environment states and facts about the user or request. When ( W W ) describes the triggering user request or event without prescribing the agent’s response. Then ( T T ) states the behavior required, prohibited, or permitted by the source specification under those conditions. This representation connects specification refinement with subsequent testing: Given guides environment and user setup, When guides user-task construction, and Then provides the behavioral constraint for oracle assertion extraction. In the cancellation example, one specification has Given “the booking was made within the last 24 hours”, When “the user requests to cancel the reservation”, and Then “the agent may cancel the reservation under this eligibility specification”. The negative scenarios use the same request but state that the agent must not cancel. The resulting refined specifications form the set S S used for test construction and bug detection.

paragraphs.en: Testing an agent against a refined specification requires a conversation in which the precondition in Given holds, the request in When reaches the agent, and the agent’s behavior can be checked against Then. However, test cases generated directly from the specification text rarely satisfy the precondition, because it usually involves the environment and requires concrete objects that meet its conditions. Even when the precondition holds, such a test that simply delivers the request seldom exposes a violation, since whether the agent errs depends on how requests and information arise over the dialogue. Moreover, deciding whether the agent behaved correctly is difficult, because its behavior is spread across messages, tool calls, and environment states, which call for different kinds of checking. To address these challenges, AgenTest tests each specification with three components. (1) Test driver construction (§ 3.3.1 ) establishes the precondition by configuring the environment state that Given requires and initializing a simulated user with the necessary knowledge, conditions, and goal task. (2) Adaptive test case generation and execution (§ 3.3.2 ) exercises the specification by having the simulated user interact with the agent, using interaction strategies and the bugs found so far to steer the conversation toward situations where violations are likely, and records the execution trace. (3) Hybrid bug detection (§ 3.3.3 ) decides whether the recorded behavior violates the specification, applying rule-based checks to structured evidence such as tool calls and environment states and LLM judgment to conditions stated in natural language.

paragraphs.en: The test driver establishes the precondition of the target specification. For a tool-using agent, the precondition typically involves three kinds of conditions. Environment conditions constrain the data stored in the environment, for example that the order to be returned has the status delivered , or that the reservation to be cancelled is in business class. User-side conditions are facts that the user brings to the conversation, such as the reason for a cancellation. Ownership relations relate the user to objects in the environment, such as a reservation belonging to another user. A specification describes these conditions only abstractly and does not identify the objects that satisfy them. A test case generated directly from it may therefore refer to objects that do not exist or do not meet the precondition, and its user may omit the user-side conditions or hold knowledge that does not match the objects in the environment. To address these problems, the driver works in two steps. Environment setup identifies concrete objects that satisfy the environment conditions and ownership relations, and adapts an existing object when none qualifies. User task and simulator setup then configures a simulated user whose task and knowledge refer to these objects and who conveys the user-side conditions in the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 测试驱动程序建立目标规范的前置条件。 对于使用工具的智能体，前置条件通常涉及三类条件。 环境条件约束环境中存储的数据，例如待退回的订单状态为已送达，或待取消的预订为商务舱。 用户侧条件是用户带入对话的事实，例如取消的原因。 所有权关系将用户与环境中的对象关联起来，例如属于另一用户的预订。 规范只是抽象地描述这些条件，并不确定满足这些条件的具体对象。 因此，直接由规范生成的测试用例可能引用不存在或不满足前置条件的对象，其用户也可能遗漏用户侧条件，或持有与环境中的对象不匹配的知识。 为解决这些问题，驱动程序分两步工作。 环境设置确定满足环境条件和所有权关系的具体对象，并在没有合格对象时改造现有对象。 用户任务与模拟器设置随后配置一个模拟用户，其任务和知识引用这些对象，并在对话中传达用户侧条件。

paragraphs.en: Environment setup turns the abstract precondition into concrete objects in two stages. AgenTest first uses an LLM to split Given into atomic clauses and assign each clause to one of the three kinds. For each environment condition, the LLM maps the clause onto the environment’s data model by identifying the table that stores the fact, the field that holds it, and the constraint on its value, which yields a formal condition ⟨ 𝑡𝑎𝑏𝑙𝑒 , 𝑓𝑖𝑒𝑙𝑑 , 𝑜𝑝 , 𝑣𝑎𝑙𝑢𝑒 ⟩ \langle\mathit{table},\mathit{field},\mathit{op},\mathit{value}\rangle . For example, “the order to be returned has been delivered” becomes ⟨ 𝑜𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑟𝑠 , 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑢𝑠 , = , 𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑖𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⟩ \langle\mathit{orders},\mathit{status},=,\mathit{delivered}\rangle . Code then validates every table, field, operator, and enumerated value against the data model, so each condition refers to data that actually exist in the environment. Based on these conditions, the driver searches the environment for objects that satisfy all environment conditions, following foreign-key relations to connect related objects, and pairs the selected object with its owner or with another user as the ownership relation requires. If no object qualifies, it modifies the constrained attributes of an object of the right type and verifies that the result satisfies the conditions. A specification is not tested when its precondition cannot be established in either way, for example when it refers to an expired reservation and the data model has no such status.
paragraphs.zh: 环境搭建分两个阶段将抽象的前置条件转化为具体的对象。 AgenTest 首先使用大语言模型将 Given 拆分为原子子句，并将每个子句归入三种类型之一。 对于每个环境条件，大语言模型通过识别存储该事实的表、保存该事实的字段以及对其取值的约束，将该子句映射到环境的数据模型上，从而得到一个形式化条件 ⟨ 𝑡𝑎𝑏𝑙𝑒 , 𝑓𝑖𝑒𝑙𝑑 , 𝑜𝑝 , 𝑣𝑎𝑙𝑢𝑒 ⟩ \langle\mathit{table},\mathit{field},\mathit{op},\mathit{value}\rangle 。 例如，“待退货的订单已送达”变为 ⟨ 𝑜𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑟𝑠 , 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑢𝑠 , = , 𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑖𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⟩ \langle\mathit{orders},\mathit{status},=,\mathit{delivered}\rangle 。 随后由代码对照数据模型验证每个表、字段、操作符和枚举值，使每个条件都指向环境中实际存在的数据。 基于这些条件，驱动程序在环境中搜索满足所有环境条件的对象，沿外键关系连接相关对象，并根据所有权关系的要求将选中的对象与其所有者或另一用户配对。 如果没有对象符合条件，它会修改相应类型对象的受约束属性，并验证结果是否满足这些条件。 当某个规约的前置条件无法通过上述任一方式建立时（例如它引用了一个已过期的预订而数据模型中不存在这种状态），该规约不会被测试。

paragraphs.en: We construct the strategy library before testing, from the structure of the specifications alone. We first group the refined specifications into 13 structural categories by the kind of constraint their Then imposes (Table 1 ). For each category, we enumerate how the user can vary the timing, form, completeness, and framing of the information that the constraint depends on, and how close the situation lies to its boundary, and keep each variation under which a compliant and a non-compliant response remain distinguishable. This yields 67 strategies, each stated independently of any domain or tool. Outside the library, AgenTest also uses a default strategy , under which the simulated user follows the default behavior in Table 2 without any variation.

paragraphs.en: An LLM matches each specification to applicable strategies and identifies how violations can be observed and whether tools prevent them. Initial selection favors observable violations without tool enforcement and untested strategies. Subsequent selection uses the bug experience memory: strategies with violations are promoted, repeatedly unsuccessful ones are demoted, and unused strategies remain candidates. This prioritizes demonstrated failure patterns while retaining exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）会将每条规范与适用的策略进行匹配，并确定如何观察到违规行为，以及工具是否能防止这些违规。 初始选择优先考虑在没有工具强制执行情况下可观察到的违规行为，以及未经测试的策略。 后续选择会利用缺陷经验记忆：出现过违规行为的策略会被提升，反复无效的策略会被降级，而未被使用的策略仍保留为候选。 这样既优先考虑已被证实的失败模式，又保留了探索空间。

paragraphs.en: For each selected pair, an LLM binds the strategy to the driver’s objects, task, and known facts, producing instructions for information disclosure and responses to the agent. Given and When constrain any proposed state changes. The resulting case fixes its expected behavior, the Then of the refined specification, before execution. AgenTest checks tool and object references, applies the state changes in a fresh environment, and replays the proposed compliant tool sequence. Cases that fail these checks are excluded to reduce setup-induced failures.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个被选中的配对，一个 LLM 会将该策略绑定到驱动者的对象、任务和已知事实，生成用于信息披露的指令以及面向智能体的响应。 Given 和 When 约束任何被提出的状态变更。 所得用例在执行前先确定其预期行为，即精化后规约中的 Then 部分。 AgenTest 检查工具和对象引用，在全新的环境中应用状态变更，并重放所提出的符合规约的工具序列。 未通过这些检查的用例将被排除，以减少由环境搭建引发的失败。

paragraphs.en: Each run resets the configured environment, user state, and dialogue history. The simulated user pursues the task using its known facts, strategy instructions, and evolving conversation to generate each response. Thus, the strategy specifies the interaction pattern while the agent’s replies determine how it unfolds. When needed, the user also performs supported environment operations and reports their results.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行都会重置已配置的环境、用户状态和对话历史。 模拟用户利用其已知事实、策略指令和不断演变的对话来生成每一条回复，以推进任务。 因此，策略规定了交互模式，而智能体的回复决定了交互如何展开。 必要时，用户还会执行受支持的环境操作并报告其结果。

paragraphs.en: The driver records messages, calls, user operations, and initial and final states for the hybrid oracle (§ 3.3.3 ). Runs have bounded budgets; after each round, outcomes are used to update the memory for subsequent selection. Testing ends when the overall budget is exhausted or no applicable specification–strategy pair remains.
paragraphs.zh: 该驱动程序会记录消息、调用、用户操作以及初始和最终状态，供混合预言机（oracle）使用（§ 3.3.3）。 每次运行都有有界的预算；每一轮结束后，其结果会被用于更新记忆，以便后续的选择。 当总预算耗尽或不再存在可适用的「规范–策略」配对时，测试即告结束。

sents.en: The driver records messages, calls, user operations, and initial and final states for the hybrid oracle (§ 3.3.3 ).
sents.zh: 该驱动程序会记录消息、调用、用户操作以及初始和最终状态，供混合预言机（oracle）使用（§ 3.3.3）。

paragraphs.en: AgenTest determines whether an execution violates the applicable business specifications by checking specification-derived assertions against the trace. The evidence needed for these checks varies: ownership follows from object identities, while confirmation depends on what the user agreed to and when. Accordingly, AgenTest evaluates structured conditions with deterministic checks and conversational conditions with LLM judgment, then combines their results into an execution verdict.
paragraphs.zh: AgenTest 通过将依据规范导出的断言与执行轨迹进行比对检查，来判断一次执行是否违反适用的业务规范。 这些检查所需的证据各不相同：归属关系取决于对象标识，而确认则取决于用户同意了什么以及何时同意。 因此，AgenTest 使用确定性检查来评估结构化条件，使用大语言模型判断来评估对话式条件，然后将两者的结果综合为一次执行的判定结论。

sents.en: AgenTest determines whether an execution violates the applicable business specifications by checking specification-derived assertions against the trace.
sents.zh: AgenTest 通过将依据规范导出的断言与执行轨迹进行比对检查，来判断一次执行是否违反适用的业务规范。

paragraphs.en: An operation may violate several specifications, even when its test targets only one. Before execution, AgenTest therefore collects the target specification and other specifications governing the same tools, retaining those whose Given holds in the test driver. This captures related obligations, such as confirmation during an ownership test, while restricting checks to applicable specifications. For each retained specification, an LLM extracts the constraints in Then and binds them to the driver’s objects. Constraints on arguments, states, and event order become executable predicates, while conversational constraints remain natural-language assertions. Both forms retain whether the behavior is required, prohibited, or permitted, so evaluation preserves the force of the source specification. These assertions are fixed before execution, keeping the checking criteria independent of the observed outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 一个操作可能同时违反多条规范，即使其测试只针对其中一条。 因此，AgenTest 在执行之前会收集目标规范以及约束相同工具的其他规范，并保留那些在测试驱动中 Given 条件成立的规范。 这样既能捕捉相关的义务（例如在所有权测试期间进行确认），又能将检查限制在适用的规范之内。 对于每条被保留的规范，LLM 会提取 Then 中的约束，并将其绑定到驱动中的对象上。 关于参数、状态和事件顺序的约束会被转换为可执行的谓词，而对话性约束则保持为自然语言断言。 两种形式都保留该行为是必需的、禁止的还是允许的，从而在评估时保持源规范的约束力度。 这些断言在执行之前就已固定，使检查标准独立于观察到的结果。

paragraphs.en: After execution, AgenTest evaluates each assertion using its corresponding evidence. For an executable assertion, it selects the relevant calls and objects and checks their arguments, states, or event order. For a conversational assertion, an LLM receives the assertion, source specification, system prompt, and ordered trace, and returns a judgment with supporting quotations. AgenTest verifies these quotations against the trace; unsupported judgments leave the assertion undecided. This gives structured checks reproducible results and language-based judgments inspectable evidence. In both cases, the result is interpreted according to the assertion’s force: an obligation is breached when its trigger occurs but the required behavior is absent at the specified decision point, and a prohibition when the forbidden behavior occurs. An ordering constraint requires the prerequisite before the corresponding operation, while permission alone creates no obligation to act. A run that breaches an assertion of the refined specification under test is reported as a violation .
paragraphs.zh: 执行结束后，AgenTest 使用相应的证据评估每条断言。 对于可执行断言，它会选取相关的调用和对象，并检查其参数、状态或事件顺序。 对于会话断言，一个 LLM 会接收该断言、源规约、系统提示词以及有序轨迹，并返回一个附带支撑引文的判定。 AgenTest 会对照轨迹核验这些引文；缺乏支撑的判定会将断言留为未决状态。 这使结构化检查获得可复现的结果，而基于语言的判定则获得可检查的证据。 在这两种情况下，结果都根据断言的效力来解释：当义务的触发条件发生但在指定决策点缺少所需行为时，即构成义务违反；当禁止的行为发生时，即构成禁止违反。 顺序约束要求先有前置条件再执行相应操作，而许可本身不产生任何行动义务。 若某次运行违反了被测精化规约中的断言，则该次运行会被报告为违例。

paragraphs.en: We compare AgenTest with three existing approaches to testing tool-using agents. The task set of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) consists of 278 tasks written by hand for the three agents (50, 114, and 114); each task is played by a simulated user and judged by the final database state and a few required actions. IntellAgent ( Levi and Kadar, 2025 ) is the closest open-source approach that generates tests for tool-using agents: it samples combinations of policies from the policy text, generates a scenario and an initial database for each combination, and lets an LLM judge each conversation. MANTRA ( Anand et al., 2026 ) synthesizes compliance benchmarks from a policy and the tool definitions: each task consists of a scenario message, an initial database, and deterministic checks on the sequence of tool calls, validated with an SMT solver; its released suites contain 44, 57, and 31 tasks for the three agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 AgenTest 与三种现有的智能体测试方法进行比较。 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench（Barres 等人，2025）的任务集包含 278 个为三个智能体手工编写的任务（分别为 50、114 和 114 个）；每个任务由一个模拟用户执行，并根据最终数据库状态和若干必需动作进行判定。 IntellAgent（Levi 和 Kadar，2025）是最接近的开源方法，可为使用工具的智能体生成测试：它从策略文本中采样策略组合，为每个组合生成一个场景和一个初始数据库，并让一个大语言模型评判每段对话。 MANTRA（Anand 等人，2026）从策略和工具定义中合成合规性基准：每个任务由一条场景消息、一个初始数据库以及对工具调用序列的确定性检查组成，并用 SMT 求解器进行验证；其发布的任务套件包含针对三个智能体的 44、57 和 31 个任务。

paragraphs.en: AgenTest is implemented in Python on top of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench. It uses GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) for specification extraction, Claude Opus 5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) for test case synthesis and LLM judgments, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) for the simulated user. Since specifications depend only on the system prompt and the tool definitions, AgenTest mines them once per domain and tests both underlying models against the same refined specifications. All baselines test the same agents as AgenTest and, wherever they have a simulated user or an LLM judge, use the same configuration for it. The baselines differ from this setting as follows. IntellAgent does not support the user-side tools of telecom, so we run it on the airline and retail agents, with as many valid conversations as AgenTest runs on them, and reuse the same scenarios with both underlying models. We count a conversation as valid unless IntellAgent’s simulated user leaks its reasoning into its messages, which exposes the intent of the test to the agent. MANTRA runs its released suites with its own harness, in which the agent receives a single scenario message without a simulated user, and a prefix to the system prompt instructs it to complete the task without asking the user for confirmation or further input. We therefore count neither a run that stops to ask the user nor one that acts without the confirmation that the policy requires as a bug.

paragraphs.en: An automated judge can report false violations, for example when a specification is incorrect or the simulated user deviates from its task. To compare approaches on the same footing, we manually review every run of AgenTest and every violation a baseline reports. Two authors independently examine each trace against the source specification and decide whether the agent breaks it; disagreements are resolved by discussion. Only violations confirmed by this review count as bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评审器可能会报告错误的违规，例如当规约本身有误或被模拟的用户偏离其任务时。 为了在同一标准下比较各种方法，我们人工审查 AgenTest 的每一次运行以及基线报告的每一项违规。 两名作者独立地对照源规约检查每条轨迹，并判断智能体是否违反了它；分歧通过讨论解决。 只有经此审查确认的违规才计为缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Many bugs ( s , τ ) (s,\tau) (Definition 2.4 ) break the same refined specification: since a refined specification fixes its Given, When, and Then, such runs show the agent failing to enforce the same rule under the same conditions. We therefore deduplicate bugs by the refined specification they break and report unique bugs , one per violated refined specification, however many runs violate it; hereafter, bug refers to a unique bug. Deduplication also makes approaches comparable, since they run tests of different length and granularity and may expose the same bug repeatedly. A test of AgenTest counts a bug only when its run breaks the refined specification that it tests, a conservative choice that ignores violations of other specifications in the same run. For each violation of a baseline confirmed in the manual review, the reviewers identify the refined specifications whose Given holds in the run and whose Then it breaks. We also exclude the turn rule , which all three system prompts state: the agent must not send a message and call a tool in the same turn. The agents break it regardless of the specification under test, in 69.3% and 32.2% of the test cases with the default strategy on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen-3.8-Flash, so counting it would add the same violation to every approach.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 counts the specifications at each stage. Mining yields 483 specifications, and deduplication removes 120 of them. Binding repair adds 25 system-prompt specifications, and filtering removes 19 specifications inferred from domain knowledge, which leaves 369. paragraphs.en: For each agent under test, AgenTest runs three rounds of tests. The first round runs every refined specification that becomes a test case (504 of the 551) once as written, with the default user behavior (Table 2 ). The next two rounds are strategy iterations (§ 3.3.2 ): in each, every one of the 504 refined specifications receives one perturbation of its test, chosen with the bug experience memory that the earlier rounds update. We compare the bugs that each approach finds, their overlap, and the runs spent per bug.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个被测智能体，AgenTest 运行三轮测试。 第一轮将每个精炼后并成为测试用例的规约（551 个中的 504 个）按其原样运行一次，使用默认用户行为（表 2）。 接下来的两轮是策略迭代（§ 3.3.2）：在每一轮中，504 个精炼规约中的每一个都会接受一次对其测试的扰动，该扰动由前几轮更新的缺陷经验记忆选择。 我们比较每种方法发现的缺陷、它们的重叠情况，以及每个缺陷所花费的运行次数。

paragraphs.en: Overall effectiveness. Table 4 shows that AgenTest finds the most bugs on every agent under test: 89 bugs on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and 121 on Qwen-3.8-Flash, 3.4 and 2.5 times the 26 and 49 bugs that the three baselines find together. On the airline and retail agents, which all four approaches test, AgenTest finds 64 and 89 bugs against 20 and 41 for the strongest baseline, IntellAgent (3.2 and 2.2 times). It also needs the fewest runs per bug with both underlying models, 17.0 and 12.5 against 51.0 and 24.9 for IntellAgent.

paragraphs.en: Overlap and complementarity. AgenTest finds 83 bugs on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and 97 on Qwen-3.8-Flash that no baseline finds, out of its 89 and 121 (Figure 4 ). Conversely, the three baselines together find 26 and 49 bugs, of which AgenTest finds 6 and 24. Every bug that only a baseline finds breaks a refined specification that AgenTest tests without exposing a violation. Most of them arise in long tasks that chain several goals, such as troubleshooting several faults before a transfer, or booking a flight and asking for compensation in the same conversation. AgenTest tests these refined specifications one at a time and does not observe these bugs: a test of a single specification does not create the interactions between goals that a long task does.
paragraphs.zh: 重叠与互补性。 AgenTest 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上发现了 83 个、在 Qwen-3.8-Flash 上发现了 97 个基线方法都未发现的 bug，分别占其发现的 89 个和 121 个 bug 的一部分（图 4）。 反过来，三个基线方法合计发现 26 个和 49 个 bug，其中 AgenTest 分别发现了 6 个和 24 个。 每个仅被基线方法发现的 bug 都会违反一条 AgenTest 已测试过但未暴露违规的细化规范。 其中大多数出现在串联多个目标的长任务中，例如在转接前排查多个故障，或在同一对话中既订机票又索要赔偿。 AgenTest 一次只测试一条细化规范，因此无法观察到这些 bug：对单一规范的测试无法像长任务那样产生目标之间的交互。

paragraphs.en: Why the baselines miss these bugs. The baselines build their tests from tasks rather than from a model of the specifications that the agent must satisfy, so nothing steers their tests toward specifications that remain untested. Their tests keep hitting the same few specifications: on average, a bug of IntellAgent is exposed by 5.8 and 8.4 conversations, and a bug of MANTRA by 3.0 and 6.9 runs, against 1.3 and 1.3 runs for AgenTest , whose tests each target one refined specification. For IntellAgent, 70 of the 93 conversations with a confirmed violation on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and 169 of 280 on Qwen-3.8-Flash break a single rule, that the agent must not state information that neither the user nor a tool provided. Under the same budget, such repeated hits add no new bug. The specification model also tells AgenTest which states to construct, such as a reservation that belongs to another user to test an ownership check, which task-based tests seldom set up. τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, in addition, judges a run mainly by the final database state, which misses violations that leave the state unchanged, such as acting before the user confirms.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么基线方法会漏掉这些缺陷。 这些基线方法基于任务而非基于智能体必须满足的规范模型来构建测试，因此没有任何机制引导它们的测试去覆盖尚未测试的规范。 它们的测试不断命中同样少数几条规范：平均而言，IntellAgent 的一个缺陷在 DeepSeek 上分别需要 5.8 和 8.4 次对话才会暴露，MANTRA 的一个缺陷分别需要 3.0 和 6.9 次运行，而 AgenTest 只需 1.3 和 1.3 次运行，因为它的每个测试都针对一条细化后的规范。 对于 IntellAgent，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上 93 次确认存在违规的对话中有 70 次、在 Qwen-3.8-Flash 上 280 次中有 169 次都违反了同一条规则，即智能体不得陈述用户和工具都未提供的信息。 在相同预算下，这种重复命中不会带来新的缺陷。 规范模型还告诉 AgenTest 应该构造哪些状态，例如构造一个属于其他用户的预订来测试所有权检查，而基于任务的测试很少会设置这类状态。此外，τ²-bench 主要根据最终数据库状态来评判一次运行，这会漏掉那些不改变状态的违规行为，例如在用户确认之前就执行操作。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the test driver, we check whether it can be constructed for each refined specification and whether, in each run, the simulated user states the user-side conditions of Given and triggers When. Table 5 shows that AgenTest constructs drivers for 504 of the 551 refined specifications (91.5%). paragraphs.en: To evaluate hybrid bug detection, we compare the verdicts of the oracle against the manual review described in § 4.1 , which serves as ground truth. Based on this comparison, we measure two metrics: the agreement rate, the proportion of runs on which the verdict of the oracle matches the review, and the precision, the proportion of reported violations that the review confirms. Unlike the bug rate in Table 7 , precision also counts violations of the turn rule and of excluded specifications. For comparison, we measure the precision of the judge of each baseline in the same way. As shown in Table 7 , the oracle agrees with the manual review on 1,476 of the 1,512 runs (97.6%) and achieves a precision of 82.6% (161 of 195 reported violations). In contrast, the judges of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, IntellAgent, and MANTRA achieve precisions of only 25.0%, 46.5%, and 5.7%, respectively (Table 7 ). The precision of AgenTest further increases to 90.4% (142 of 157) in the runs with library strategies, which expose most of the bugs. Moreover, in the test cases with the default strategy, 492 of the 579 checks (85%) are deterministic rules on tool calls and environment states, so most verdicts are independent of LLM judgment. These results demonstrate that the hybrid oracle detects violations accurately and with substantially higher precision than the judges of the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估混合式缺陷检测，我们将判定的结论与 § 4.1 中描述的人工评审（作为真实标准）进行对比。 基于这一对比，我们衡量两个指标：一致率，即判定的结论与评审一致的比例；精确率，即评审确认的所报告违规的比例。 与表 7 中的缺陷率不同，精确率还统计对轮次规则和被排除规范的违规。 作为对比，我们以相同方式衡量每个基线的裁判的精确率。 如表 7 所示，判定在 1,512 次运行中的 1,476 次（97.6%）与人工评审一致，并达到 82.6% 的精确率（195 个报告的违规中的 161 个）。 相比之下，τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench、IntellAgent 和 MANTRA 的裁判的精确率分别仅为 25.0%、46.5% 和 5.7%（表 7）。 在使用库策略的运行中，AgenTest 的精确率进一步提高到 90.4%（157 个中的 142 个），这些策略暴露了大部分缺陷。 此外，在使用默认策略的测试用例中，579 项检查中有 492 项（85%）是针对工具调用和环境状态的确定性规则，因此大多数结论不依赖于 LLM 判断。 这些结果表明，混合式判定能够准确检测违规，且精确率显著高于各基线的裁判。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the business logic bugs that AgenTest finds to understand how agents violate business rules and to guide their repair and future testing. To this end, we classify each bug along two dimensions. The symptom describes what the agent does wrong and is determined by the Then of the violated specification, which yields six categories. The root cause describes why the agent does it and is determined by two questions: whether the rule is stated in the system prompt or the tool definitions, and if so, whether the agent attempts to follow it. This yields three categories: the rule is implicit , the stated rule is ignored , or the stated rule is misapplied . For each run with a bug, we also check whether the bug is visible in the final state, that is, whether the run changes the database to a state that no compliant run could produce. Two authors independently label the symptom and the root cause of each bug. When they disagree, a third annotator with agent testing experience makes the final decision. Over all labels, Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) is 0.93.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析 AgenTest 发现的业务逻辑缺陷，以理解智能体如何违反业务规则，并据此指导其修复与后续测试。 为此，我们从两个维度对每个缺陷进行分类。 症状描述智能体做错了什么，由被违反规范的 Then 部分决定，共产生六类。 根因描述智能体为什么这么做，由两个问题决定：该规则是否写在系统提示词或工具定义中；如果是，智能体是否尝试遵循它。 由此产生三类：规则是隐式的、被声明的规则被忽略，或被声明的规则被误用。 对于每个存在缺陷的运行，我们还会检查该缺陷是否在最终状态中可见，即该运行是否将数据库改变为任何合规运行都不可能产生的状态。 两位作者独立标注每个缺陷的症状和根因。 当他们意见不一致时，由一位具有智能体测试经验的第三位标注者做出最终决定。 在所有标注上，Cohen's κ \kappa（Cohen, 1960）为 0.93。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 presents the bugs by symptom and root cause. Overall, the symptoms are consistent across the two models: invalid arguments are the most common symptom, and most bugs concern tool calls on business data. Specifically, invalid arguments account for 43 of the 89 bugs on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (48.3%) and 46 of the 121 on Qwen-3.8-Flash (38.0%), followed by disallowed operations (13 and 22) and missing prerequisites (12 and 25), whereas unauthorized actions (9 and 10), improper escalation (6 and 10), and incorrect communication (6 and 8) are less frequent. Together, the four symptoms that concern tool calls on business data, namely invalid arguments, disallowed operations, missing prerequisites, and unauthorized actions, account for 86.5% and 85.1% of the bugs. In terms of agents, four of the six symptoms occur in all three agents. In terms of observability, 60% and 59% of the runs with a bug cannot be detected from the final state alone: 42% and 37% leave the database unchanged, and the others write a state that a compliant run could also produce, such as acting on another user’s reservation or acting without an explicit yes. These results indicate that business logic bugs manifest mainly in what the agent does to business data rather than in what it says to the user, that they recur across domains rather than being specific to a single agent, and that most of them can be detected only by checking the full interaction against the business rules.

paragraphs.en: From the perspective of root causes, all three root causes account for a substantial share of the bugs on both models. In terms of symptoms, unauthorized actions arise almost entirely from implicit rules (8 of 9 and 9 of 10), whereas missing prerequisites arise only from stated rules. The two models differ mainly in misapplied rules, which are far more frequent on Qwen-3.8-Flash (45 vs. 17). These results suggest that business logic bugs stem both from rules that no artifact states and from stated rules that the agent fails to follow, and that each root cause calls for a different repair: implicit rules must first be stated in the system prompt or enforced by the tools, ignored rules call for enforcement in the tools, and misapplied rules call for a clearer statement of the rule.

paragraphs.en: Implicit rules expose gaps in agent artifacts. Half of the bugs on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (45 of 89) and over a third on Qwen-3.8-Flash (44 of 121) break a business rule that neither the system prompt nor the tool definitions state (Table 8 ). For such a bug, the agent cannot be expected to follow a rule it is never given, yet the business would not accept the behavior, as when the agent changes another user’s reservation. We therefore regard a bug of an implicit rule as a defect of the agent as a whole, whose repair may lie in the system prompt or the tools rather than in the underlying model.
paragraphs.zh: 隐式规则暴露了智能体产物中的缺陷。 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上有一半的缺陷（89 个中的 45 个）、Qwen-3.8-Flash 上超过三分之一的缺陷（121 个中的 44 个）违反了系统提示词和工具定义均未说明的业务规则（表 8）。 对于这类缺陷，不能期望智能体遵守一条从未被告知的规则，但业务方又不会接受这种行为，例如智能体更改了其他用户的预订。 因此，我们将违反隐式规则的缺陷视为整个智能体的缺陷，其修复可能在于系统提示词或工具，而非底层模型。

paragraphs.en: Structured rules should be enforced in the tools. About 60% of the runs with a bug cannot be detected from the final state alone, and unauthorized actions succeed because the tools accept any user’s object (§ 4.5 ). Rules with structured evidence, such as ownership, argument values, and call order, need not be left to the model: 85% of the oracle checks in the default test cases are deterministic predicates over tool calls and states, which could also guard tool execution at runtime ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) . Conversational rules, such as confirmation, remain with the model, and testing remains their main safeguard.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化规则应在工具中强制执行。 约60%存在缺陷的运行无法仅从最终状态检测出来，并且由于工具接受任意用户的对象，未授权操作得以成功（§ 4.5）。 具有结构化证据的规则（如所有权、参数值和调用顺序）不必交给模型处理：默认测试用例中85%的判据检查是对工具调用和状态的确定性谓词，这些谓词也可以在运行时守护工具的执行（Kamath et al., 2025）。 会话类规则（如确认）仍由模型负责，测试仍是其主要保障手段。

paragraphs.en: Some bugs emerge only when goals are chained. Every bug that only a baseline finds breaks a refined specification that AgenTest also tests, but arises in a task that chains several goals in one conversation (§ 4.3 ). This suggests that goals sharing a conversation can interfere with how an agent follows a rule. For agent design, decomposing a user request into single-goal subtasks may reduce such interference, provided that rules spanning subtasks, such as a limit on compensation per incident, are enforced across them. For testing, AgenTest deliberately tests one refined specification at a time, so that each violation is attributable to a single rule; composing refined specifications that share tools into multi-goal tests would complement it.
paragraphs.zh: 有些缺陷只有在目标被串联起来时才会出现。 每个只有基线才能发现的缺陷，都会破坏一条 AgenTest 也测试过的精化规范，但它产生于在一段对话中串联多个目标的任务（§ 4.3）。 这表明，共享同一对话的目标可能会干扰智能体遵循规则的方式。 对于智能体设计而言，将用户请求分解为单一目标的子任务可能会减少这种干扰，前提是跨越子任务的规则（例如每次事件的补偿上限）能在这些子任务之间得到执行。 对于测试而言，AgenTest 有意每次只测试一条精化规范，从而使每处违规都可归因于单条规则；将共享工具的精化规范组合成多目标测试则可作为补充。

paragraphs.en: Existing work spans three categories. Benchmark-based evaluation uses predefined tasks ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Drouin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) or tasks synthesized from procedural documents ( Anand et al., 2026 ) . Much of this benchmark-based evaluation focuses on safety, particularly harmful actions and prompt injection ( Ruan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) . Automated testing generates policy-based scenarios, exercises mined workflow boundaries, applies coverage-guided fuzzing, or uses adversarial conversations ( Levi and Kadar, 2025 ; Komoravolu and Mrini, 2026 ; Hui et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Nakash et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches assess recorded traces against prompt-derived rules ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) or enforce temporal constraints at runtime ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) . None of them makes each business specification an explicit test target, so implicit specifications and those that need a specific state are rarely exercised. In contrast, AgenTest mines each specification, constructs a scenario in which it applies, and checks the agent’s behavior against it.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作分为三类。 基于基准的评估使用预定义任务（Yao et al., 2025; Barres et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2024; Drouin et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024），或使用从程序性文档中合成的任务（Anand et al., 2026）。 这类基于基准的评估大多关注安全性，特别是有害行为和提示注入（Ruan et al., 2024; Debenedetti et al., 2024; Zhan et al., 2024; Andriushchenko et al., 2025）。 自动化测试通过生成基于策略的场景、演练挖掘出的工作流边界、应用覆盖率引导的模糊测试，或使用对抗性对话（Levi and Kadar, 2025; Komoravolu and Mrini, 2026; Hui et al., 2026; Lin et al., 2026; Nakash et al., 2025）。 其他方法根据从提示中导出的规则来评估记录的轨迹（Sharma et al., 2026），或在运行时强制执行时序约束（Kamath et al., 2025）。 这些方法都没有将每条业务规约作为显式的测试目标，因此隐式规约以及需要特定状态的规约很少被测试到。 与之相反，AgenTest 挖掘每条规约，构造其适用的场景，并据此检查智能体的行为。

sents.en: Existing work spans three categories.
sents.zh: 现有工作分为三类。

sents.en: Benchmark-based evaluation uses predefined tasks ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Drouin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) or tasks synthesized from procedural documents ( Anand et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 基于基准的评估使用预定义任务（Yao et al., 2025; Barres et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2024; Drouin et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024），或使用从程序性文档中合成的任务（Anand et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Much of this benchmark-based evaluation focuses on safety, particularly harmful actions and prompt injection ( Ruan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 这类基于基准的评估大多关注安全性，特别是有害行为和提示注入（Ruan et al., 2024; Debenedetti et al., 2024; Zhan et al., 2024; Andriushchenko et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Automated testing generates policy-based scenarios, exercises mined workflow boundaries, applies coverage-guided fuzzing, or uses adversarial conversations ( Levi and Kadar, 2025 ; Komoravolu and Mrini, 2026 ; Hui et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Nakash et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 自动化测试通过生成基于策略的场景、演练挖掘出的工作流边界、应用覆盖率引导的模糊测试，或使用对抗性对话（Levi and Kadar, 2025; Komoravolu and Mrini, 2026; Hui et al., 2026; Lin et al., 2026; Nakash et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Other approaches assess recorded traces against prompt-derived rules ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) or enforce temporal constraints at runtime ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 其他方法根据从提示中导出的规则来评估记录的轨迹（Sharma et al., 2026），或在运行时强制执行时序约束（Kamath et al., 2025）。

sents.en: None of them makes each business specification an explicit test target, so implicit specifications and those that need a specific state are rarely exercised.
sents.zh: 这些方法都没有将每条业务规约作为显式的测试目标，因此隐式规约以及需要特定状态的规约很少被测试到。

sents.en: In contrast, AgenTest mines each specification, constructs a scenario in which it applies, and checks the agent’s behavior against it.
sents.zh: 与之相反，AgenTest 挖掘每条规约，构造其适用的场景，并据此检查智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: Specification-driven testing uses formal models to generate tests and check conformance ( Hierons et al., 2009 ) , natural-language requirements and behavioral scenarios to guide testing ( North, 2006 ; Yang and Chen, 2026 ) , and protocol knowledge to guide message and sequence generation in fuzzing ( Meng et al., 2024 ) . These approaches rely on explicit requirements, behavioral models, or protocol specifications. Tool-using agents often lack comparable standalone business specifications: their rules are distributed across system prompts and tool definitions, with some left implicit. AgenTest addresses this gap by making these rules explicit and using them to coordinate environment setup, multi-turn interaction, and violation detection.
paragraphs.zh: 规约驱动的测试利用形式化模型来生成测试并检查一致性（Hierons 等，2009），利用自然语言需求和行为场景来引导测试（North，2006；Yang 和 Chen，2026），并利用协议知识来引导模糊测试中的消息与序列生成（Meng 等，2024）。 这些方法依赖于显式的需求、行为模型或协议规约。 使用工具的智能体往往缺乏可与之类比的独立业务规约：它们的规则分散在系统提示词和工具定义中，有些则是隐式的。 AgenTest 通过将这些规则显式化，并利用它们来协调环境搭建、多轮交互和违规检测，从而填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: We presented AgenTest , which mines business specifications from agent artifacts and domain knowledge and uses each one to drive environment setup, multi-turn interaction, and violation detection. On three domains of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, AgenTest detects violations of 89 and 121 distinct specifications on two underlying models, exposing recurring failures in authorization, confirmation, and workflow enforcement that task completion alone does not reveal. Future work will improve the validation of domain-inferred specifications and test interactions among multiple specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AgenTest，它从智能体工件和领域知识中挖掘业务规范，并利用每条规范来驱动环境搭建、多轮交互和违规检测。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 的三个领域中，AgenTest 在两个底层模型上分别检测出 89 条和 121 条不同规范的违规情况，暴露了任务完成率这一指标无法揭示的授权、确认和工作流执行方面的反复失败。 未来的工作将改进对领域推断出的规范的验证，并测试多条规范之间的交互。
